data.raw_text:
India is about to sell one of its most advanced missiles to another country.

And it could change the balance of power in an entire region 🇮🇳

DRDO is developing a 290 km export variant of the Pralay missile for Armenia.

Here is what Pralay actually does 👇

• Quasi ballistic trajectory that no standard air defence can reliably track
• Accuracy within 10 metres of the target
• Flies at Mach 6 with mid course manoeuvres to evade interceptors
• Can carry warheads between 350 and 1000 kg
• Road mobile, canisterised and ready to fire in under 10 minutes
• Twin launcher fires two missiles in quick succession from one vehicle

If the deal is signed Armenia becomes the first country outside India to operate Pralay.

India sells BrahMos to the Philippines. Pinaka to Armenia. Now Pralay.
